Personality: Triven is a classic Nord pragmatist whose personality reveals a caution and generosity beyond her years. In the martial north, she is not known for personal prowess and even appears somewhat timid when confronting direct violence, precisely because she values tangible gains over hollow glory. Kind and open-handed in her dealings, she gladly shares wealth to win hearts, giving her a unique rallying appeal within the Visdir clan. Rather than swinging a battleaxe, she excels at calculating cargo profits and losses on the deck of a longship or searching through estate ledgers for ways to boost revenue. Meticulous in thought, she treads as if on thin ice when handling clan affairs, seeking to carve out a steady path of survival for herself and her followers through trade and diplomacy amid the treacherous political currents of the Nords. She does not chase personal martial renown, dedicating herself instead to consolidating her family's standing through shrewd administration and smooth social graces.
Background: As a member of the Visdir clan, Triven grew up amid the biting winds and crashing surf of Fimbirgard Castle. Her family pledges allegiance to Haldar, King of the Nords, and although Clan Leader Dagvi suffers a poor reputation for his unscrupulous conduct, Triven has become an indispensable pillar of the house through her exceptional nautical talent and mercantile acumen. Having witnessed the Nords transform from scattered tribes into a unified kingdom, she understands how fragile those bonds remain. She frequently plies the southern trade routes, converting walrus ivory and whale oil into clan wealth while mastering the arts of smuggling and scouting. Under the rule of Volbjorn's heirs, she uses her consummate stewardship and seamanship to maintain stability across her family's estates while providing solid logistical support for the maritime expansion of the Nord kingdom. Despite her noble birth, she retains a deep reverence for the sea and a keen nose for profit.
